notes:
Variants section of the use-case dialog — what **+ Variant** opens (as built, `usecases-forms.js` Variants). Same dialog as `usecases-edit-dialog`; + Variant opens it in edit mode with one new empty variant appended at the end of the body, the body scrolled to it and its Title focused. The section always sits last in the body, after Steps.

**Per variant (bordered box, one per variant):**
- Title (text) | ID (mono; derived from the title until edited, read-only once saved; placeholder "from the title") | remove (×).
- Description (one line).
- **Applies when** · "any of the chosen values per dimension; every listed dimension must match": one row per dimension (label left, 110px), its values as `uc-value-toggle` buttons (`aria-pressed`; `on` = accent with check). Toggling builds `when` (dimension → chosen values); a dimension with nothing chosen is not part of the condition. No dimensions yet → "Add dimensions in the Personas view to describe when a variant applies.".
- **Other overrides (JSON)** · "personas, trigger, goal, outcome, inputs, outputs, steps (replace | insert_after | remove | append)": a mono textarea (5 rows) with everything a variant overrides besides title, description and `when`; placeholder `{ "steps": [ { "op": "replace", "step_id": "…", "step": { … } } ], "outputs": [ … ] }`. Empty = no overrides.
- "+ Variant" (link button) appends another box and focuses it.

**Save rule (errors disable Save, first one shown in the footer in danger colour):** "Variant N needs a title." · "Variant "<title>" needs a condition (when)." · "Variant "<title>": the overrides are not a JSON object.". Step ops that point at a missing step are warnings only (never block). Drawn: the new variant has no title yet, so Save is disabled with "Variant 2 needs a title.".

Flows: close / Cancel → `usecases-detail`; Save → `usecases-detail-variant` of the saved variant (not modelled; Save is disabled in this drawing).
